function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact temperature right now. For the most accurate and up‑to‑date weather in Riga, check a reliable source such as:

- Your phone’s weather app  
- A weather website (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the Latvian Hydrometeorological Service)  
- A quick Google search for “Riga weather”  

Those will give you the current temperature, forecast, and any alerts.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How hot is it now in Riga?" They want current temperature. We need to provide weather info. There's no tool for weather. We can respond with approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking a weather website. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking local weather.
